# Vendored rendering resources: licenses and attribution

Retrieved 2026-11-05 from the primary project repositories. These license files accompany the vendored CSS, JavaScript and webfonts. Retain original copyright/license comments in the minified resources.

| Resource | License | Included text | Primary source |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Source Sans Pro / Source Sans | SIL OFL 1.1 | `SOURCE-SANS-OFL.txt` | https://github.com/adobe-fonts/source-sans/blob/release/LICENSE.md |
| Open Sans | SIL OFL 1.1 | `OPEN-SANS-OFL.txt` | https://github.com/google/fonts/blob/main/ofl/opensans/OFL.txt |
| Roboto | SIL OFL 1.1 | `ROBOTO-OFL.txt` | https://github.com/google/fonts/blob/main/ofl/roboto/OFL.txt |
| Font Awesome 4.5.0 fonts | SIL OFL 1.1 | `FONT-AWESOME-4.5.0-FONT-OFL.txt` | https://github.com/FortAwesome/Font-Awesome/blob/v4.5.0/README.md |
| Font Awesome 4.5.0 CSS | MIT | `FONT-AWESOME-4.5.0-CODE-MIT.txt` | https://github.com/FortAwesome/Font-Awesome/blob/v4.5.0/src/license.html |
| Bootstrap 3.3.6 | MIT | `BOOTSTRAP-3.3.6-MIT.txt` | https://github.com/twbs/bootstrap/blob/v3.3.6/LICENSE |
| jQuery 1.12.0 | MIT; original external-library notice retained | `JQUERY-1.12.0-LICENSE.txt` | https://github.com/jquery/jquery/blob/1.12.0/LICENSE.txt |

Font Awesome attribution: **Font Awesome by Dave Gandy — http://fontawesome.io**. Its font's embedded copyright is “Copyright Dave Gandy 2015. All rights reserved.” The v4.5.0 repository links to the standard OFL and MIT terms rather than containing a combined LICENSE file; the two included Font Awesome text files combine its published license assignment with the applicable full standard terms. The OFL terms are reproduced from the primary Google Fonts OFL text; the MIT terms are reproduced from Bootstrap's versioned MIT text, without attributing Bootstrap's copyright to Font Awesome.

Google Fonts serves a point-in-time font build; these are the current upstream family license texts retrieved for the copied family resources, while `../manifest.json` records the exact downloaded font hashes. The fonts themselves were not modified. CSS `url()` references were localized only; CSS declarations were preserved.

Bootstrap's Glyphicons Halflings font files are part of the Bootstrap distribution. Bootstrap's project documentation credits [Glyphicons](https://glyphicons.com/); this credit is retained here.

These notices do not replace the original website's separate MIT license or cover unrelated images, text or institutional marks.
